purpose: Accumulate prospective, causal, outcome-blind positive E filings as append-only shadow observations until a precommitted diversity/information threshold is reached; only then may a separate outcome-observation contract be designed and authorized.

problem_elimination_pass.final_user_goal: Build enough causal evidence-event observations to test an evidence-anchored Setup without expensive historical backfill, semantic overengineering, or repeated chat-driven polling.
hard_constraints: Only prospectively observed official issuer filings after V2.8.4 activation may enter the V2.8.12 shadow ledger.
A shadow row requires a complete ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE record with resolved issuer identity and a conservative effective signal date from existing V2.8.4 authority.
Historical V2.8.11 reconstructed positives never seed or count toward prospective shadow readiness.
No price, return, benchmark, D+5/D+10 outcome, fold3 or fold4 data may be read before the V2.8.12 readiness gate passes and a separate outcome contract is frozen.
No change to E classifier, triage, keywords, identity rules or effective-date semantics.
No Setup, First60, Episode or live authorization.
problem_elimination_pass.soft_problem_deleted: Do not build an NLP system that decides whether two positive filings describe the same underlying commercial project before enough prospective observations exist.
problem_elimination_pass.replacement: Treat each unique positive official filing as one shadow filing-event observation. Preserve same-issuer recurrence explicitly, but measure research readiness using issuer/date/month diversity and issuer concentration rather than pretending repeated filings are independent issuers.

Delete: No semantic project-lineage clustering in V2.8.12.
No full historical backfill or extra historical windows.
No manual tagging of filings as 'new project' versus 'progress update' for readiness counting.
Avoid: Do not count the same announcement twice.
Do not count historical reconstructed events toward the prospective threshold.
Do not let repeated filings from one issuer dominate readiness.
Absorb: Reuse V2.8.4 announcement_id/object conflict rules, issuer identity binding, page-scoped classification and conservative next-trading-date effective rule.
Reuse the existing prospective scanner and GitHub Actions cadence rather than chat-driven polling.
actions.Substitute: Use simple append-only filing-event observations plus issuer recurrence metadata instead of subjective semantic event clustering.
actions.Precompute_Reuse: Persist content hashes, decision hashes, evidence sentence hashes and prior-issuer linkage once; duplicate announcements become no-ops.
actions.Optimize: Event-family stratification or technical overlays are deferred until after the minimum prospective sample exists and the outcome contract is frozen.

shadow_event_definition.name: PROSPECTIVE_POSITIVE_E_FILING_EVENT
shadow_event_definition.qualifying_source: A committed V2.8.4 prospective finalization receipt effective_positive_events entry whose underlying observation-ledger row is PROSPECTIVE and ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE.
required_conditions: announcement_id is new to the V2.8.12 shadow ledger
canonical_security_id is valid and matches the V2.8.4 observation record
source_object_sha256 and decision_sha256 are bound to the same announcement
effective_signal_date is the existing conservative first joint A-share trading date strictly after the authoritative observation date
nonqualifying: NOT_ESTABLISHED, EXCLUDED_AI_ADOPTER_ONLY, EXCLUDED_AI_RND_ONLY or BLOCKED_AMBIGUOUS classifications
positive classification with unresolved issuer identity

issuer_recurrence_policy.later_positive_for_issuer: Append as a separate filing-event observation with issuer_positive_sequence_number incremented and recurrence_status = SUBSEQUENT_POSITIVE_FOR_ISSUER.
issuer_recurrence_policy.rationale: Repeated filings remain observable facts but are not assumed to be independent commercial projects or independent issuers.

invariants: issuer_positive_sequence_number is deterministic from earlier committed shadow rows only
prior_positive fields are empty for sequence 1 and bind exactly to sequence N-1 for sequence N>1

genesis.reason: This event was genuinely prospective, causally observed and ratified under V2.8.4 before V2.8.12; it is not a historical reconstruction.

readiness_gate.purpose: Authorize drafting and execution of a separately frozen outcome-observation research contract; it does not establish alpha or authorize Setup.
requires_all: positive events occur in >= 6 distinct calendar months
maximum share of shadow filing-events from any one canonical_security_id <= 0.20
no price or return data have been consumed by the shadow accumulation process
readiness_gate.if_not_ready: Continue blind append-only prospective accumulation; do not notify or rerun outcome research.
readiness_gate.if_ready: Freeze V2.8.13 prospective E-event outcome-observation contract before any post-event price/return resolution.

automation_architecture.design_requirement: Implementation should absorb V2.8.4 prospective E observation plus V2.8.12 shadow append/readiness audit into a GitHub Actions scheduled cadence. Do not create an hourly polling loop.
automation_architecture.cadence_intent: One workday-morning collection cycle is sufficient; overlapping 3-calendar-day scan plus announcement_id deduplication handles missed/nontrading days.
automation_architecture.concurrency_requirement: Use a single non-overlapping E-layer/shadow accumulation concurrency group or a serialized workflow path to avoid concurrent ledger writes.

implementation_validation_required: Genesis creates exactly one shadow row from announcement 1225573666 and imports zero V2.8.11 historical rows.
Exact duplicate announcement is a no-op.
First issuer positive gets sequence 1 and empty prior-positive linkage.
Second positive for the same issuer gets sequence 2 and links exactly to the previous issuer row without semantic project inference.
A positive for a different issuer starts sequence 1.
Readiness counts repeated issuer filings toward total events but only unique securities toward issuer diversity.
20 events with fewer than 12 issuers cannot pass.
20 events with one issuer share above 20% cannot pass.
All readiness conditions can pass only without any price/return fields or imports.
Historical V2.8.11 positive files are absent from ingestion sources.
Scheduled collection is serialized and retains V2.8.4 no-backfill/no-same-day semantics.
forbidden: No outcome resolver or price source import in the V2.8.12 shadow accumulator.
No D+5/D+10 computation or hidden preview before readiness PASS.
No semantic event-family NLP, manual event grouping or manual issuer selection.
No classifier/triage/keyword relaxation to accelerate accumulation.
No Setup, First60, Episode or live emission.
